description: The whole price list for this server's paid doors, in dollars, cheapest first. Use it to budget BEFORE committing to a call — without it the only way to learn a price is to call a door and read the 402 it answers with. Prices are read from the live door manifest, never a hand-kept table, so a door that changes price cannot leave a stale number quoted here; the door's own 402 challenge remains the final price truth. Free, keyless, read-only. There is no balance to top up: you pay each call from your own wallet at the moment you call.

maxUsd.description: Optional ceiling — show only doors costing this much or less.
